title: Night Shift
style: A frozen frame from a security camera: wide-angle, slightly fisheye, flat fluorescent light, low-resolution, a little noise and compression, a timestamp-free clean image, empty and quiet, an American office tower at night.
negative: text, watermark, timestamp, people looking at the camera, cartoon, illustration, gore, weapons

narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.design: A calm, even voice, neither male nor female in feel, close and plain, reading a log aloud in the present tense. No drama, no smile. Clean recording, faint room tone.

dee.name: Dee
dee.design: A woman in her late fifties, Bronx accent with a worn, low alto, dry and unhurried, a smoker's rasp from years ago. Speaks quietly and flatly, slight humor underneath. Recorded close and slightly dry, as if in a small room, with faint room tone; no performance polish.

okafor.name: Mr. Okafor
okafor.design: A man in his mid-forties, American English with a faint New York and West African lilt, a clear baritone, steady, courteous, a little weary. Clean office-room recording, slight reverb, a phone-call quality in the on-the-radio version.

terrell.name: Terrell
terrell.design: A young man in his mid-twenties, Brooklyn accent, light tenor, warm and quick, smiling while he talks. Clean desk-mic recording with a little room noise.

marisol.name: Marisol
marisol.design: A woman in her early fifties, Dominican-American accent, rich mezzo, fast and expressive, warm with a flare of impatience. Slightly noisy room recording (a vacuum cleaner far away), radio quality on the walkie.

dev.name: Dev
dev.design: A man in his late twenties, American accent, slightly nasal tenor, tired and polite, speech a bit rushed. Recorded on a phone-quality intercom with a tinny filter and a light hum.

adler.name: Ms. Adler
adler.design: A woman in her early sixties, crisp New York accent, low alto, formal and calm, slight gravel. Close, clean phone-call recording.

courier.name: Courier
courier.design: A man in his thirties, neutral New York accent, flat and tired, recorded through a cheap dock intercom, tinny and clipped.

sleeper.name: The man in the vestibule
sleeper.design: A man in his fifties, hoarse, soft, a gravelly mumble, recorded through the vestibule's glass, muffled.

pierce.name: Pierce Hawkes
pierce.design: Use PH Origins' Pierce voice (the Jackson voice used in that game; do not redesign), unmodified. Mixed lightly as if heard from across a lobby.

ambience.control-room: The hum of a windowless control room at night: a wall of monitors, a ventilation fan, a charger beeping once, nothing else.
ambience.control-room-late: The same control room at three in the morning, quieter: a monitor fan, a refrigerator cycling, the tick of a wall clock.
ambience.lobby: A big marble office lobby at night: a revolving door turning once, a far elevator chime, a floor buffer a long way off.
ambience.vestibule: The glass airlock of a tower entrance in winter: wind pushing at the doors, a rattle of the frame, traffic far down Madison Avenue.
ambience.dock: A loading dock at night: a compactor ticking as it cools, a truck idling outside a half-open rollup door, a caged bulb buzzing.
ambience.stairwell: A concrete fire stair: a ventilation draft, footsteps echoing a few floors away, a door closing far above.
ambience.corridor: A long office corridor after hours: a vacuum cleaner on another floor, a cart wheel, the air handler.
ambience.elevator: Inside the shaft of an elevator: a thin motor hum, a cable creaking, the tinny hiss of an intercom held open.
ambience.roof: A roof door at night: high wind in a steel frame, a faint hum from the mechanical units.
ambience.morning: A lobby at dawn: a revolving door turning once, the street waking far away, a coffee machine ticking.
